description: Fetch annual international trade-in-services data. Classification EB (default) serves each reporter-period as reported, in its own scheme (EB10, EB10S or EB02 codes); EB10 or EB02 selects UN Comtrade's conversion of other schemes into that one. Each row names its classification and whether it is original or converted. Same bilateral structure as goods trade: returns flow value in USD, period, and reporter/partner/category metadata for each row. Use comtrade_list_service_categories to find a service code and its scheme before querying. Keyless preview makes one request per served period, at least 4 seconds apart, capped at 500 records per request. Services coverage is more limited than goods trade.

classification.description: Services classification. EB (default): each reporter-period as reported, in its own scheme (EB10, EB10S or EB02 codes). EB10 or EB02: UN Comtrade's conversion of reports from other schemes into that one; reports made in it stay under EB. EB10S has no converted series; its rows are served only under EB. Case-insensitive; blank means EB.

partner_code.description: M49 partner code. Use 0 for all partners combined (World). Omitting it can return World alongside the partner breakdown.

period.description: Annual periods YYYY. Serves the first 8 distinct periods keyless (12 with authenticated access); the rest, and any period whose request is rate limited, fails on a UN Comtrade server error or network failure, or runs out of time, are listed in unservedPeriods. Input ceiling 120.

reporter_code.description: M49 numeric code of the reporting country (0–999).

service_code.description: Service category code in one scheme: "7" (EB10), "SG" (EB10S) and "260" (EB02) are each financial services. Under EB a code returns rows only for periods reported in its scheme; comtrade_list_service_categories lists codes with their schemes. Omit to get every category the reporter reported, at mixed levels: totals (200 for EB10 and EB02, S for EB10S) beside their components, so do not sum the rows.

name: comtrade_get_services_trade

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_reporter_filter`: Reporter omission lacks an explicit partner. `upstream_validation`: UN Comtrade rejects the query dimensions. `invalid_upstream_response`: UN Comtrade returns malformed services data. `rate_limited`: No served period completed and UN Comtrade rate-limited at least one through its retries. `upstream_unavailable`: No requested period completed and at least one request failed on a UN Comtrade server error or network failure after retries. `deadline_exceeded`: No served period completed within the call's time budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: World overlap warnings, period failures, and guidance for empty results, including EB scheme coverage, ISO-3 counterpart codes, or partner_code 158 for Taiwan services.

items.description: A single services trade flow record.

classificationCode.description: Actual services classification edition on the returned row.

isOriginalClassification.description: True when the row is in the scheme the reporter used; false when UN Comtrade converted it into the requested classification.

isReported.description: True if directly reported; false if estimated.

referenceNotice.description: Reference descriptions unavailable; codes and values retained.

totalCount.description: Sum of upstream response counts before local filtering; not a full match count when capped.

truncated.description: True when any preview response reached 500 and may be incomplete.

truncationHint.description: Query narrowing and authenticated access guidance when possibly incomplete.

unservedPeriods.description: Periods not served: past the period cap (8 keyless, 12 authenticated) or whose requests were rate limited, failed on a UN Comtrade server error or network failure, or ran out of time; query them separately.

title: Get Services Trade Data
